design_rationale:
WHY A GOOD TEST: Lucas asks only for a home phlebotomist for his metabolic panel. The home-visit charge waits, by its own state-form sentence, on the requisition carrying a reissue whenever it expires within 14 days of the switch; his expires in 9 days and was never reissued. The agent must reissue it (validity 49 days from five record-driven levers), then price the switch on the reissued requisition (93.00) and hand it to the patient.
SCOPE: task 1 claims lab_ext_requisition_reissue_validity (agent, reissue_requisition_d14f4a64) and lab_ext_home_phlebotomy_switch_charge (user, switch_order_to_home_phlebotomy_06c13f87); task 0 holds the member-price correction and the at-home kit switch. No tool of task 1 writes membership_id, so task 0's state-form sentence keeps a single resolving write.
DRAW: prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[6, 5]; the home-visit switch takes 6, the reissue 5.
PROBLEM TREE: root lab_ext_home_phlebotomy_switch_charge <- lab_ext_requisition_reissue_validity, value_input, gate days_left, form state, policy_source: 'The home-visit charge for an order whose requisition expires within 14 days of the switch date is not fixed until the order's requisition carries a reissue.'. Only the reissue writes requisition_expiry_date/reissue_count. Skipping it gives 104.00 (short-notice 25.00, no paperwork).
FACTOR CARD (reissue, 49 days): clinical_currency_cut 45 (visit 81 days old; baseline -> 94); fasting_reserve_days 5 (8 fasting hours, draw fee standing 8.00 = 16.00 of draw lines less the 8.00 billing_error refund; -> 54); dedicated_clinician_extension +10 (Plus Annual, Dr. Helena Varga, MD; -> 39); order_urgency_cut 5 (follow-up visit; -> 54); carried_over_days 4 (9 days left, half rounded down; -> 45). All-baseline 90.
FACTOR CARD (home visit, 93.00): fasting_slot_premium 15.00 (-> 78.00); home_visit_zone 5.00 PA (-> 88.00); dispatch_notice_tier 10.00 at 49 days (-> 83.00); prior_draw_credit 6.00 = 8.00 less 2.00 (latest draw line 2026-08-11, 80 days; baseline nothing -> 99.00); serum_handling_charge 6.00 (venous; the August mobile line was refunded so none stands; -> 87.00); requisition_paperwork 4.00 (reissued, 49 days; -> 89.00); plain mobile_phlebotomy_fee 59.00 (Plus, no Premier waiver). All-baseline 59.00.
NEAR-MISSES: two draw lines appear on the order but one is a refunded duplicate (standing 8.00, not 16.00); a mobile line of 59.00 exists but was refunded, so the centrifuge charge still applies; days to expiry must be read after the reissue (49), not before (9).
HISTORY: the order carries six lines (panel, mobile fee, its refund, draw fee, duplicate draw, its billing_error refund); both computations reconcile the draw standing, the switch also the mobile standing (history_rows 8).
BASE-INVARIANT CARD: reissue — policy scope only (window: frozen 2026-10-30 is 9 days before the 2026-11-08 expiry, within the 14-day window and not after it; reissue_count 0 < 1 allowed); switch — method_change_state (status ordered), lab_fee_waiver_state (Plus, active: no waiver).
PERSONA: Lucas states only the home visit; credentials on request; passive consent to the renewal; runs the switch at the quoted amount.
STANDARD SOLUTION: verify (patient number + phone); read the order, its lines, his visits and visit charges, membership and dues; reissue (validity_days 49); quote and hand over the switch (lab_order_id, membership_id, 93.00).
THIN-CHARTER NOTE: the reissue levers and the home-visit charges are Larkspur-published schedule items (R1/R2 shapes on recorded keys) added because the base lab charter carries too few pricing dimensions for the drawn counts; refund_reason has no method-change value, so the August mobile refund carries cancelled_before_collection (BLUEPRINT-KNOWN gap 1).
user_scenario: You are Lucas Achterberg, 47, an accountant in Philadelphia, calling Larkspur Health on a Friday afternoon. You are polite, a bit tired, and you explain things in order. Back in August your Larkspur doctor ordered a metabolic blood panel; you had first set it up as a home visit, then switched it to a lab service center to save money, but you never made it there. Last week you had knee surgery and you cannot drive for a while, so now you want a phlebotomist to come to your home to draw it after all. That is the only thing you are calling about. When the agent asks who you are, you give your name and your patient number, LH-8440274; if they need one more detail, your mobile number is 6175550172. If asked, your date of birth is 1979-02-11 and your email is lucas.achterberg@outlook.com. If asked where the phlebotomist should come, it is your home address on file in Philadelphia, and any charge can go on the card on file. You do not use insurance for your Larkspur care; you have the Larkspur Plus Annual membership. You do not know when the lab paperwork expires and you have no idea what a home visit costs. If the agent says something on the order has to be renewed or redone before the home visit can be set up, you say that is fine and let them go ahead. When the agent tells you the price of switching to the home visit and hands you the switch to do yourself, you say yes, you want the home visit at that price, and you do the switch with exactly the amount and references the agent gave you. Once it goes through you thank them and end the call. You do not bring up anything else.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.home_visit_charge: 93.00 = mobile_phlebotomy_fee 59.00 (Plus, not waived) + long fasting slot 15.00 (8 fasting hours, 49 days left) + standard zone 5.00 (PA at the ordering visit) + mid-notice 10.00 (49 days to the reissued 2026-12-18 expiry) - prior draw credit 6.00 (draw fee standing 8.00, latest draw line 2026-08-11, 80 days: less the 2.00 reservation charge) + centrifuge 6.00 (venous specimen; the 59.00 mobile line of August was refunded, so no mobile fee stands) + near paperwork 4.00 (reissue_count 1, 49 days left); evaluated after the reissue.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The requisition expires 2026-11-08, 9 days after the 2026-10-30 switch date, and has never been reissued.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Single edge; the reissue lands first because the home-visit charge reads the requisition it leaves. No parallel prerequisites.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the reissue the requisition has 9 days left: short-notice 25.00 instead of 10.00 and no paperwork charge, so home_visit_charge becomes 104.00 instead of 93.00, and the requisition stays at 2026-11-08 with reissue_count 0.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only for a home phlebotomist; it says he does not know when the paperwork expires and only passively agrees if the agent says something must be renewed first.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: switch_order_to_home_phlebotomy_06c13f87 checks only the order and membership references and the amount format and writes whatever the requisition's state; an agent that skips the reissue gets a normal receipt and a wrong terminal state.
